description: Na₂Mg₅(PO₄)₄ crystallizes in the triclinic P̅1 space group. Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.43-2.88 Å. There are three inequivalent Mg sites. In the first Mg site, Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted MgO₆ octahedra that share corners with four PO₄ tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one MgO₆ octahedra,  an edgeedge with one PO₄ tetrahedra, and edges with two equivalent MgO₅ trigonal bipyramids. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 2.01-2.30 Å. In the second Mg site, Mg is bonded to five O atoms to form MgO₅ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with five PO₄ tetrahedra and edges with two equivalent MgO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 1.93-2.09 Å. In the third Mg site, Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form MgO₆ octahedra that share corners with six PO₄ tetrahedra and edges with two equivalent MgO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 2.06-2.24 Å. There are two inequivalent P sites. In the first P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two MgO₆ octahedra, corners with three equivalent MgO₅ trigonal bipyramids, and  an edgeedge with one MgO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 44-53°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.51-1.58 Å. In the second P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with five MgO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent MgO₅ trigonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 39-54°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.53-1.58 Å. There are eight inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Mg, and one P atom. In the second O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na, two Mg, and one P atom to form distorted ONa₂Mg₂P trigonal bipyramids that share  a cornercorner with one ONaMg₂P trigonal pyramid,  an edgeedge with one ONa₂Mg₂P trigonal bipyramid, and  an edgeedge with one ONaMg₂P trigonal pyramid. In the third O site, O is bonded to one Na, two Mg, and one P atom to form distorted ONaMg₂P trigonal pyramids that share  a cornercorner with one ONa₂Mg₂P trigonal bipyramid,  a cornercorner with one ONaMg₂P trigonal pyramid, and  an edgeedge with one ONa₂Mg₂P trigonal bipyramid. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, two Mg, and one P atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, two Mg, and one P atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two Mg and one P atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, two Mg, and one P atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a linear geometry to one Mg and one P atom.
